card.name: The digit 1 starting a number
card.fires_on: The digit "1" (or the word "one") that begins a multi-digit number or quantity, right before more digits like 00, 0%, .8 or .5. Seen mostly in dose, concentration, volume and percentage text.

modes.label: Leading 1 in doses and volumes
modes.description: A "1" that opens a number such as 100 mg, 100 mL or 1.5 g in preparation instructions.

modes.label: Leading 1 in percentages
modes.description: A "1" that starts a percentage or concentration, such as 10% dextrose or 1.8% of patients.
modes.example: -Pd and <<1>>.8% of patients treated with P

card.writes: It promotes unit words such as grams, hours, dollars and bytes, so it expects a unit after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit 1 of a number, when a unit like mg, mL or % is about to follow.
